rows.label: qst500111_msg0002
rows.name:
Please try Twinklejuice, the Twelve
Nopon Siblings' proud creation, mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0003
rows.name:
And our eagerly awaited newest
creation is currently in development,
mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0004
rows.name:
The twelve siblings are scattered
across Alst looking for ingredients
for delicious juice, mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0005
rows.name: What do we say to that?

rows.label: qst500111_msg0008
rows.name:
We don't keep in touch until we find
our ingredients, mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0009
rows.name:
It's so everyone can find what they
think is the ultimate ingredient
without being swayed by others, mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0010
rows.name:
So I have no idea where anyone is,
mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0012
rows.name:
The ingredients Mitamita found are a
trade secret, mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0014
rows.name:
What Mitamita found was...
Sweet Wasabi, mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0016
rows.name:
Mitamita jammed a finger and couldn't
go very far, mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0017
rows.name:
So Mitamita quickly gathered some on
Goldmund, then came back to help mind
the shop, mooo!

rows.label: qst500111_msg0018
rows.name:
Please don't scold Mitamita any more,
mooo!
